scripts.demo:mobile: pnpm build:mobile-sdk && pnpm build:demo && pnpm --filter mobile-sdk-demo start
scripts.docstrings:sdk: pnpm tsx scripts/docstring-report.ts "packages/mobile-sdk-alpha/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" --label "Mobile SDK Alpha" --write-report docs/coverage/sdk.json
scripts.format: SKIP_BUILD_DEPS=1 pnpm format:root && pnpm format:github && GRADLE_USER_HOME="$PWD/.gradle-home" pnpm --filter @selfxyz/kmp-sdk format && GRADLE_USER_HOME="$PWD/.gradle-home" pnpm --filter @selfxyz/kmp-sdk-test-app format && pnpm native-shell:format && SKIP_BUILD_DEPS=1 pnpm -r --if-present --filter "!self-workspace-root" --filter "!@selfxyz/kmp-sdk" --filter "!@selfxyz/kmp-sdk-test-app" run format
scripts.format:root: echo 'format markdown' && node ./node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --parser markdown --write '*.md' 'docs/**/*.md' 'specs/**/*.md' && echo 'format yaml' && node ./node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --parser yaml --write .*.{yml,yaml} --single-quote false && node ./node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern 'scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}' && node ./node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --parser json --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern 'scripts/**/*.json'
scripts.native-shell:lint: cd packages/native-shell-android && ./gradlew ktlintCheck && cd ../../packages/native-shell-ios && swiftlint lint --strict
scripts.kmp:clean: pnpm --filter @selfxyz/kmp-sdk clean && pnpm --filter @selfxyz/kmp-sdk-test-app clean && rm -rf packages/kmp-sdk/.gradle packages/kmp-sdk/build packages/kmp-sdk/shared/build packages/kmp-sdk-test-app/.gradle packages/kmp-sdk-test-app/build packages/kmp-sdk-test-app/composeApp/build
scripts.reinstall-app: pnpm install && (cd app && pnpm clean:watchman && pnpm clean:build && pnpm clean:ios && pnpm clean:xcode && pnpm clean:pod-cache && pnpm clean:android-deps && pnpm clean:ruby && pnpm clean:node) && pnpm install && pnpm --filter @selfxyz/mobile-app run install-app
